scope: Reuse the exact E3E material/probe set and references. Characterize two isolated numerical changes only; do not qualify on the tuning set.

variants.change: Apply the existing t^8 GL8 endpoint transform to the first unsaturated segment adjacent to h=0 when the face starts at positive surface head. Keep quarter-decade segmentation, GL8 lanes, 64 bisection iterations and all constitutive physics unchanged.

After variant A, if the physical q bracket has no sign change, compare absolute residual at the lower and upper physical endpoint and return the closer endpoint rather than always forcing the lower K(h_above) endpoint. Record which endpoint is selected and compare that choice against the full-accuracy reference.

cost_policy: No increase in GL lanes per segment. Report observed constitutive K evaluations and root residual evaluations; no production cost claim.
selection_rule: If variant A alone resolves generic B12/O13 failures, preserve it independently. Variant B is only considered for bracket failures and must select the same physical endpoint as the reference-nearest endpoint on every encountered bracket failure.
hard_nonclaims: No new holdout evidence; the exact E3E probes are reused diagnostically.
